notes.title: 🥣 Welcome to Corbaci: A Cozy Cinematic Horror! 🖤
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620239/f31f4ced008caf611dcff2323e3f04c16b04c942.png"]
Hello, fellow wanderers of the eerie and the cozy! 👻

We’re thrilled to welcome all our new followers to the world of Corbaci, where simmering soups and unsettling stories blend into a unique horror experience.


🍲 What’s Cooking?
In our latest update, we’ve stirred the pot with:

Enhanced Cinematic Flow: Smoother transitions and immersive storytelling to keep you on edge.

Visual Tweaks: Adjusted effects for a more comfortable experience—though the eerie ambiance remains intact.

Bug Fixes: Addressed camera glitches and other minor issues to ensure a seamless journey.
[hr][/hr]🧠 What’s Next?
The full release is simmering and will be served in Q4 2025. Until then, we invite you to:

Wishlist the game to stay updated.

Join the Community: Share your thoughts, theories, and screenshots.

Explore the Prologue: Available now on Steam to get a taste of the mystery.
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for being part of this hauntingly cozy adventure. We can’t wait to share more with you soon!

Stay spooky and stay cozy. 🖤

— The Corbaci Team

notes.title: 🎉 Welcome New Followers! | 欢迎新关注者！
notes.content:
Hey everyone – and a warm welcome to all our new followers!

The full release of CORBACI is just around the corner, and we’re incredibly excited to show you what’s cooking.
We’ve been hard at work polishing the experience based on your feedback. Here’s a quick look at what’s new:

🛠️ Fixed a few nasty camera bugs (no more spinning heads – unless they're meant to spin...)

🧠 Reduced the brain-melting visual effects (but you can still turn them back on if you dare)

🎥 Improved the cinematic experience and overall flow

🍜 Tweaked some soup secrets… but those you’ll have to discover yourself

This game is made with a lot of love and a little bit of unease – just the way we like it. Thanks for being part of this strange little journey.

Wishlisting, sharing, and feedback are all super appreciated.
More updates (and creepy stuff) coming soon.

— The CORBACI Team
